Tiny bubbles rising slowly. Green aquatic plants slightly wilted from heat. Condensation droplets on outer glass surface. Dark moody room behind. Shot on Canon R5, 85mm macro, f/2.0, shallow depth of field. Professional documentary photography. Vertical 9:16. Lower third is dark negative space for text overlay. The water is slightly cloudy and warm-tinted. Very few bubbles visible suggesting low oxygen. Green aquatic plants in midground looking limp. image_prompts.scene3_broken_heater: A cracked glass aquarium heater partially submerged inside a water-filled aquarium. video1_thermometer_to_temperature.prompt: Cinematic transition inside a water-filled planted aquarium. Camera slowly pulls back from a close-up of a glowing red thermometer reading 34C to reveal a wider view showing the dramatic temperature difference between night and day. The water color gradually shifts from warm reddish to a split cool-blue and warm-orange tone. Fish visible swimming become increasingly stressed. Suspenseful documentary atmosphere. Film grain.
video1_thermometer_to_temperature.negative_prompt: Empty aquarium, no water, cartoon, bright cheerful, text on screen.
video1_thermometer_to_temperature.audio: Deep tension drone. Ticking clock sound. Muffled underwater ambience.

video2_temperature_to_oxygen.prompt: Underwater cinematic transition inside a heated aquarium. Camera slowly descends from water surface level downward then tilts back up. The water gradually becomes hazier and warmer-tinted. Bubbles become fewer and fewer. Fish that were swimming normally begin rising toward the surface gasping with open mouths. Green plants slowly droop and wilt. The atmosphere shifts from tense to suffocating. Dramatic warm overhead lighting intensifies.
video2_temperature_to_oxygen.negative_prompt: Active bubbles, healthy swimming fish, clear cool water, bright lighting, cartoon, text, empty tank.
video2_temperature_to_oxygen.audio: Heartbeat slowing down. Bubbling fading to silence. Low frequency suffocating drone.

video3_oxygen_to_danger.prompt: Dramatic underwater shot inside a water-filled aquarium. Camera slowly pans from stressed fish gasping at the surface downward toward a glass heater tube. As the camera reaches the heater a crack suddenly appears with a brief bright white flash. Tiny bubbles violently escape from the fracture. Fish dart away in panic. Water shimmers with electrical distortion. The scene momentarily goes dark then returns with eerie red emergency lighting. Alarming forensic documentary atmosphere.
video3_oxygen_to_danger.negative_prompt: Calm scene, intact equipment, happy fish, bright cheerful mood, cartoon, text, empty aquarium without water.
video3_oxygen_to_danger.audio: Eerie silence building. Sudden glass crack. Electrical buzz. Fish splashing. Then dead silence.

reel.caption:
أسماكك ممكن تموت بالصيف وأنت ما تدري ليش.

3 أسباب خطيرة ما يعرفها 90% من المبتدئين:

السبب الأول — تذبذب حرارة الحوض بالليل.
الفرق 3 درجات بس يكفي يقتل أسماكك.

السبب الثاني — الحرارة العالية تسحب الأوكسجين من المي.
أسماكك تختنك وأنت نايم.

السبب الثالث — السخان القزاز ممكن يطق ويكهرب الحوض كله.

الحل؟ باچر.
احفظ هالريلز وأرسله لأي صاحب حوض قبل ما يفوت الوقت.

#أسماك_الزينة #حوض_سمك #fishtok #aquarium #fishkeeping #العراق #بغداد #tropicalfish #aquariumhobby #AQUAVO
